mechanism: L-MC1: build G once in weight calibration and store it (ridge already applied), and load it in the dynamic path instead of rebuilding it with cholesky_inverse(cholesky(h_inv)) on every call

sole_change_measured.byte_level: three substring substitutions, each asserted unique; the shadows are derived from the parent's own text and appended
substitution_sites: _em1_compile_metric: add the metric key to the payload
_em1_metric: load the metric instead of rebuilding it

single_file_import: verify.py control A imports the six APIs from a bare temporary directory
shadows_live: both appended definitions shadow the parent's (co_firstlineno) and are resolved by name
equivalence_is_exact_not_tolerance_based: the five HiF4 fields are compared as raw bytes on CUDA, and the stored G is compared byte for byte against the G the parent rebuilds at call time
shard_decision_note: 336 exactly zero is the predicted reading for a bitwise-equivalent candidate; a non-zero delta would be the defect
pairing_method: one eval.py process carrying both sides; per-case delta re-derived here as candidate.gain - baseline.gain keyed by case_id

stopped_early_flag.why: the stop check runs after a shard's results are appended, and this candidate is bitwise-equivalent to its parent, so delta_mean == 0 on every shard and the counter reaches --stop-after-nonpositive 6 exactly on the last requested shard.
